gates.requiredScope: The eligible intake, Ready series review, feature identity, branch, accepted hashes, run state and current MergeAndSync authority remain aligned.
gates.rationale: Documentation delivery requires immutable intake lineage and current explicit authority.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any intake, review, series, branch, authority, task or state drift.

gates.requiredScope: Seven general guide topics, every example guide and every DocumentationAndPublishing reconciliation statement have complete, unique and evidence-backed closure rows.
gates.rationale: Cardinality and traceability are the feature's primary acceptance contract.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any guide, example inventory, reconciliation row, evidence path or closure decision change.

gates.requiredScope: Learner-facing documentation is German-first and English-second at CEFR-B2, semantically structured, UTF-8 clean and usable through text-first assistive tools.
gates.rationale: Language and accessibility are formal completion criteria for the new guides.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any learner-facing text, structure, navigation or accessibility change.

gates.requiredScope: DocFX, Release CS1591, Playwright/Axe and the existing Pages publishing workflow pass reproducibly without tracked generated output.
gates.rationale: Guide and navigation changes trigger the repository's complete documentation publishing proof path.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any Markdown, XML comment, API, navigation, DocFX, Pages or accessibility change.

gates.requiredScope: Operational multi-Mac and agent guidance uses agy, legacy Gemini references are classified, maintained agent surfaces remain homogeneous and repository templates stay unchanged unless explicitly justified.
gates.rationale: The accepted intake requires current, non-duplicated agent workflow guidance.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any agent surface, command, skill, workflow, template or compatibility wording change.

gates.requiredScope: Diff, format, secrets, supply-chain applicability, source-reference boundaries, project statistics and scope exclusions remain valid; no product or generated-output change enters the delivery set.
gates.rationale: Documentation-only scope still requires repository integrity and governance evidence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any source, test, dependency, project, example, generated output, statistics or governance drift.

gates.requiredScope: The exact reviewed feature head is pushed, all mandatory GitHub technical checks pass, no actionable review thread remains and provider-neutral PreMerge evidence validates.
gates.rationale: Remote delivery requires exact-head technical and review convergence before any bypass decision.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any head, workflow, check, review thread, comment or authority change.

gates.requiredScope: Only after every technical gate passes, the authorized admin bypass may cover the sole remaining approval rule; merge commit, branch cleanup, main synchronization and causal PostMerge evidence complete the run.
gates.rationale: The latest user instruction explicitly grants MergeAndSync and a narrow approval-only bypass.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any failing technical gate, actionable review, merge failure, cleanup failure or default-branch drift.
